verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS invoicing product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or tracking controls. The security claims (PCI-DSS, SSL, 2FA) are an adjacent feature, not a telemetry opt-out, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
